In this video I build an AI cluster using the Olares One as my master node orchestrator and a couple of Minisforum MS02 Ultra as the worker nodes to create custom applications that solve a specific problem: Localizing region locked movies and series. I also built a custom hardware monitoring app that shows how the cluster resources are being used in real-time. All of this was achieved using natural language and Olares’s own AI agent, along with Qwen 3.8, a free LLM that you can use yourself!

Olares Cluster guide: https://www.olares.com/docs/manual/best-practices/install-olares-multi-node#set-up-a-multi-node-olares-cluster
